Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummarySubtitle: A seven-day summary of readiness, habits, and training load for faster weekly review.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryNarrativeBody: Across {sessions} sessions, average readiness held at {readiness}, average habit score reached {habits}, and average load landed at {load}. {strongest} carried the week best, while {focus} needs the clearest support next.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryStrengthBody: {strongest} remained the steadiest positive signal through a {readiness} average readiness week.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryConstraintHabits: Habit adherence slipped this week, so {focus} needs more structure outside the session.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryConstraintReadiness: Weekly readiness stayed lower than target, so {focus} should shape the next support conversation.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryConstraintLoad: Training load averaged {load}, so the next review should confirm that load is not masking the support picture.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryNextRecovery: Use next week to protect quality first and rebuild confidence around {focus}.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryNextHabits: Set one simple routine target around {focus} and keep the next week more accountable.
Dashboard.athleteWeeklySummaryNextBuild: Keep building through {strongest} and turn it into a stronger carryover for the rest of the profile.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionChecksBody: You closed {checks} of {total} green signals, so today should stay in {mode} mode with attention on sleep, fuel, and recovery basics.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionModeBodyFull: Today's state supports more demanding technical work. Keep quality high and use the stronger state well.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionModeBodyModerate: Today's state is solid but not peak. Keep the work organized and avoid unnecessary chaos.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionModeBodyLight: Today's state needs a lighter, cleaner day. Prioritize recovery and technical control over intensity.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionFocusBody: Put extra attention on {focus} today. That is the clearest area where better choices will help tomorrow.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionMomentumBodyRising: Recent form is trending up by about {delta}. Keep the routine stable and build on what is working.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionMomentumBodySteady: The recent pattern is steady. Small disciplined wins today are more valuable than drastic changes.
Dashboard.athleteDailyActionMomentumBodyFalling: Recent form is down by about {delta}. Simplify the day and protect recovery before pushing harder.

Dashboard.sessionBlueprintStandardSummary: {support} athletes need support, {watch} need monitoring, and {missing} are still missing today. Keep the standard session and use normal coach touchpoints.
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintControlledSummary: {support} athletes need support, {watch} need monitoring, and {missing} are still missing today. Keep the session structured but reduce open-load volume and increase coach check-ins.
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintRecoverySummary: {support} athletes need support, {watch} need monitoring, and {missing} are still missing today. Shift the group toward recovery-first quality, smaller spaces, and lower total load.
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintControlledStep1: 0-6 min · Longer activation and mobility · extend readiness prep before speed or contact
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintControlledStep2: 6-16 min · Clean technical repetitions · emphasize first-touch quality and reduced chaos
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintControlledStep3: 16-26 min · Decision rondo under controlled pressure · keep scanning active without overload
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintControlledStep4: 26-34 min · Short confidence block + breathing reset · finish with quality and low fatigue spillover
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintRecoveryStep1: 0-8 min · Recovery activation and breathing · downshift tension before technical work
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintRecoveryStep2: 8-18 min · Low-chaos technical rhythm · prioritize touch quality and body feel
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintRecoveryStep3: 18-26 min · Small-group support block · coach-led reps with clear cueing and pauses
Dashboard.sessionBlueprintRecoveryStep4: 26-32 min · Reflection, mobility, and exit check · close the session before fatigue compounds

Dashboard.planningLaneTue: Keep the group structured and build clean repetitions before adding open pressure.
Dashboard.planningLaneWed: Use the most stable day for standard quality work and normal decision speed.
Dashboard.planningLaneThu: Re-check support athletes and keep the session tight if fatigue starts to rise again.

Assessment.appSubtitle: 2-minute daily wellness tracker for young athletes
Assessment.noImages: No reports or evidence files recorded for this athlete.
Assessment.uploadSecurityNote: Images are uploaded securely. Upload is blocked until photo/video consent is checked.
Assessment.rapidSpiderSummarySubtitle: Average scores across this athlete's rapid surveys
Assessment.cameraUnsupported: Camera is not supported on this device/browser.
Assessment.cameraAccessError: Unable to access camera. Please allow camera permission.
Assessment.coachModeFull: Full performance mode. Keep high intensity and two-touch decisions.
Assessment.coachModeModerate: Moderate readiness. Controlled pressure with clean execution.
Assessment.coachModeLight: Low readiness detected. Reduce load and prioritize technical quality.
Assessment.readinessEvaluationSubtitle: Complete all 7 checks to determine session intensity and coach adaptation.
Assessment.liveDrillSubtitle: Execution screen adapted from the legacy timer flow.
Assessment.deleteSurveyBody: This will permanently remove the selected survey.
Assessment.technicalPillarPrompt: First touch quality, clean execution, and finishing composure under pressure.
Assessment.tacticalPillarPrompt: Scanning, positioning, and decision timing before and after receiving.
Assessment.cognitivePillarPrompt: Attention control, pattern recognition, and processing speed in fast phases.
Assessment.physicalPillarPrompt: Daily recovery habits, body feel, and fuel support for training.
Assessment.mentalPillarPrompt: Mood, pressure, and confidence before the session starts.
Assessment.sportBrainPillarPrompt: Focus and learning readiness for smart decisions in training.
Assessment.sleepHoursPrompt: For most young athletes, the target is roughly 9-12 hours at ages 6-12 and 8-10 hours at ages 13-18.
Assessment.sleepQualityPrompt: Think about whether sleep felt deep, calm, and refreshing.
Assessment.energyTitle: How much energy do you have?
Assessment.energyPrompt: Your body should feel ready to move, not flat or drained.
Assessment.bodyFeelPrompt: Heavy soreness or pain is a flag to adjust load, not push through.
Assessment.fuelHydrationPrompt: Think about breakfast, snacks, and whether water intake is on track.
Assessment.moodPrompt: A daily mood check can catch stress before it spills into training.
Assessment.stressLoadPrompt: Include school, life, and sport pressure together.
Assessment.confidencePrompt: Confidence shapes how freely a young athlete trains and competes.
Assessment.focusTitle: How focused is your sport brain?
Assessment.focusPrompt: Sleep, stress, and overload often show up first as reduced focus.
Assessment.blueprintStandardStep1: 0-6 min · Activation and mobility (Readiness) · prime your body for quality actions
Assessment.blueprintStandardStep2: 6-18 min · First-touch ladder (Technical) · improve clean reception under movement
Assessment.blueprintStandardStep3: 18-28 min · Scan-receive-pass rondo (Cognitive/Tactical) · increase pre-receive speed
Assessment.blueprintStandardStep4: 28-36 min · Confidence finishing block (Psychological/Technical) · commit to decisive actions
Assessment.blueprintStandardStep5: 36-42 min · Breathing reset + reflection (Readiness/Psychological) · protect quality under fatigue
Assessment.blueprintQuickStep4: 12-15 min · Reset breathing and session notes

Legal.scopeBody: These terms govern use of the Survey platform and related services.
Legal.serviceBody: Survey supports athlete assessment workflows, records management, and reporting for authorized staff.
Legal.responsibilityBody: Users are responsible for accurate data entry, lawful processing, and safeguarding account access.
Legal.privacyCollectionBody: Survey processes assessment records, profile information, metadata, and uploaded evidence necessary for service delivery.
Legal.privacyUseBody: Data is used for assessment documentation, trend analysis, reporting, and service operation.
Legal.privacyRetentionBody: Records are retained according to legal and contractual obligations; access is role-based and audited.
